messages.author: d87216285ace7535
messages.subject: Re: [dartR] Re: Error in gl.read.dart: Individual names are not unique.
parts:
Here is an approach I use to check this error. It probably isn't the most
efficient way to do it, but it works for me. I copy the row of individual
names, (click on the first cell, then hit control-shift-right arrow, then
hit control-c), go to a new sheet, use paste special and transpose it
(bottom right option in the dialogue box that opens). Then, highlight
that column, go to insert, then choose pivot table (left option on the
ribbon). Select the first column name (by clicking the box beside it),
then also drag the highlighted column name down to the lower right option,
sum values. This counts the number of times each value is present. Copy
and paste both columns of data from the pivot table to their own columns,
then sort or filter them to find if you have any values > 1. Those are
the duplicate names that must be changed before you can read in your data.

I'm sure Arthur has a far more efficient way of doing this though. :-)

Cheers
Peter Unmack
